name: deviantdrop
description: Telegram bot on Cloudflare Workers: paste a DeviantArt link (artwork page or fav.me) and get the image, video or GIF back.
author: redtidev1918

scripts.deploy:vps: bash -c 'test -n "$SERVER" || { echo "Set SERVER=user@host"; exit 1; }; npm run check && git push origin main && ssh "$SERVER" "cd /opt/deviantdrop && git pull --ff-only && docker compose up -d --build"'
scripts.logs: bash -c 'test -n "$SERVER" || { echo "Set SERVER=user@host"; exit 1; }; ssh "$SERVER" "docker logs -f deviantdrop-deviantdrop-1"'
